scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @paperlane/web" "npm run dev -w @paperlane/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @paperlane/content && npm run build -w @paperlane/web && npm run build -w @paperlane/api
scripts.start: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run start -w @paperlane/web" "npm run start -w @paperlane/api"
